run_perturb_systems_main: run the main function to rattle images along a relaxation pathway at 5 different variances
create_perturbed_structures: create perturbed atomic structures by rattling images at variances 0.005 to 0.5 and writing VASP POSCAR files
generate_vasp_input_files: generate VASP calculation input files including KPOINTS, POTCAR, and POSCAR for each perturbed structure
generate_slurm_job_scripts: generate SLURM submission scripts with unique job names, output, and error files for each perturbation step
read_ase_trajectory_files: read ASE trajectory files and enumerate images along a relaxation pathway for perturbation
